entities.summary: Johnathan Lee Williams III is an American professional basketball player for Suwon KT Sonicboom of the Korean Basketball League (KBL). He played college basketball for the Gonzaga Bulldogs. He spent two seasons with the University of Missouri Tigers men's basketball team before deciding to transfer before the 2015–16 season.
